svg.aria-label: Input-output linearization of dx1/dt = a sin x2, dx2/dt = −x1 squared + u with output y = x2 and a = 1. The feedback u = x1 squared + v with v = −2(y − yd) makes the output converge to yd = 0.5 like a stable first-order system (left), but the hidden state x1 obeys dx1/dt = a sin y and grows without bound, as t sin 0.5 (right)
